summary: Adds receive.autogc=false to the shared hosted-autonomy fixture bare remote and a regression test that forces loose-object maintenance thresholds, performs a real repair store read and write, and asserts no maintenance or gc process starts; passport-work-trial_test uses makeRig, so its real Git maintenance step no longer races detached receive-side writers.

evidence: tests/host/hosted-autonomy-rig.ts:371-384 sets receive.autogc=false on the fixture bare remote before any seeded push, so store pushes cannot detach receive-side maintenance.
tests/host/passport-work-trial_test.ts:163-166 aliases makeRig as maintenanceRig, so the flaky real Git maintenance test in passport-work-trial_test uses the hardened fixture.

tests/host/hosted-autonomy-rig_test.ts:15-64 forces loose-object maintenance thresholds, performs a real repair store read and write, and asserts the GIT_TRACE2_EVENT trace contains no maintenance or gc start event.
tests/host/hosted-autonomy-rig_test.ts:8-10 exercises the same makeRig path used by the passport test.
